meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 现在当你问起任何“Tip:”行时，Claude 会先运行 senpi --list-tips 获取实时提示，再读取你的 senpi 设置判断你确实能看到哪些，然后打开对应功能的源码核实真实机制，最后用你提问的语言深入解释并列出依据文件。若代码与提示文字不符，以代码为准。
howto.when: 当你说“give-me-tips”、问某条“Tip:”行的含义或机制，或想知道当前环境有哪些提示可见时触发。

say.text: 帮我解释一下刚才那条“Tip:”行具体在讲什么？
say.note: 技能会先查实时提示列表和你的设置再解释。

say.text: give-me-tips，这条提示背后靠什么机制实现？
say.note: 技能会打开对应源码核实后详细说明。

say.text: 我当前能看到哪些提示？为什么是这些？
say.note: 技能会读取你的 senpi 配置来回答可见范围。

howto.what_en: Asked about any Tip: line, Claude runs senpi --list-tips, reads your settings to see which tips you can see, and checks source code before explaining in your language, citing files. Code wins if tip text conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'give-me-tips', ask about the meaning or mechanism of a 'Tip:' line, or ask which tips are visible to you.

say_en.text: Explain what that 'Tip:' line actually means.
say_en.note: It first fetches the live tip list and reads your settings.

say_en.text: give-me-tips, what mechanism is behind this tip?
say_en.note: It opens the real source code and cites files before answering.

say_en.text: Which tips can I currently see?
say_en.note: It reads your senpi settings to tell you the exact visible set.
